eligibility_note: These five tickets are reconstructed from the already-frozen J11 model candidate pool plus pre-cutoff statistical/context research. Because the research process had accidental exposure to some J11-result snippets before this reconstruction was created, these tickets MUST NOT be counted as blind predictive evidence, promotion evidence, ROI/CLV evidence, or used to retune the model. The original MODEL_ONLY freeze remains the clean comparator.
temporal_input_rule: Selection rationale may use only information dated no later than 2025-03-07 18:59 America/Mexico_City. No J11-generated match data is intentionally used in any rationale or probability.
joint_probability_rule: Simple product of leg probabilities; independence approximation only, not a calibrated joint probability and not an EV claim.

tickets.label: CE_P1_PRIMARY
tickets.rationale: Best qualitative agreement between model, pre-cutoff team profiles and context while avoiding winner dependence in two of three legs.

tickets.label: CE_P2_PRIMARY

tickets.rationale: Diversified across minimum-total, team ceiling and team scoring floor; supported by pre-cutoff goal production/concession profiles.

tickets.label: CE_P3_AGGRESSIVE
tickets.rationale: Lower joint probability but three distinct match theses; avoids requiring a specific match winner.

tickets.label: CE_P4_HIGH_P_SHADOW
tickets.rationale: High nominal probabilities but each leg sits above the legacy V0.1R support ceiling; shadow-only calibration probe.

tickets.label: CE_P5_HIGH_P_SHADOW
tickets.rationale: Wide ceiling markets with strong nominal model probabilities, preserved strictly as out-of-envelope shadow observations.

settlement_policy: After this file is committed, J11 outcomes may be revealed. Settle these tickets descriptively but exclude them from blind-evidence aggregates. Settle the pre-existing MODEL_ONLY freeze separately as the clean comparator.
